title: The Pale Portrait
author: Marguerite Ravensworth
blurb: Noor Coldharbour, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
